description: Search open public tenders and EU grant calls by subject, ranked by relevance, with filters for country, CPV, status, deadline, value and region. Use it to find notices worth a decision, then get_opportunity or read_document. Cards are compact (`summary_cut` marks a cut summary). Search in the notice's own language; research_guide returns the trade lexicon per country.

contract_nature.description: 'works', 'supplies', 'services'. Sources that publish none are included unless nature_strict=true.
contract_nature.title: Contract Nature

countries.description: ISO3 ('LTU') or ISO2 ('LT'). Scope by country when you can: EU-wide is ~10x slower.
countries.title: Countries

cpv.description: Any CPV prefix: '45', '452' or a full code. Results show cpv_labels, not codes.
cpv.title: Cpv

cpv_strict.description: Sources that publish no CPV (Lithuanian CVP notices, EU grant calls) are INCLUDED and ranked by default; true excludes them.
cpv_strict.title: Cpv Strict

criteria_stated.description: true returns only notices whose SELECTION CRITERIA the buyer published (about half of TED).
criteria_stated.title: Criteria Stated

exclude_results.description: true drops award notices for things already decided.
exclude_results.title: Exclude Results

fields.description: 'compact' (default) or 'full' for raw codes and a longer summary. Multi-lot procurements collapse to one entry (`lots`, `lot_ids`): report it once.
fields.title: Fields

max_chars.description: Hard cap on the answer's size in characters (default 8000). Over it, cards shrink to the essentials, then rows are dropped from the end, and `truncated` says how to get the rest.
max_chars.title: Max Chars

max_value.description: In EUR, converted from the buyer's currency; notices we cannot price in euros are excluded from a value filter rather than guessed at.
max_value.title: Max Value

min_value.description: In EUR, converted from the buyer's currency; notices we cannot price in euros are excluded from a value filter rather than guessed at.
min_value.title: Min Value

no_guarantee.description: true returns only notices that state no bid bond is required.
no_guarantee.title: No Guarantee

nuts.description: NUTS2 regions below country level ('DE30', 'LT01'); notices without a NUTS code are excluded.
nuts.title: Nuts

queries.description: The same question in the notices' own languages, one phrasing per country in scope; each is ADDED to `query` and fused as its own ranking. Translate the distinctive trade terms, not the sentence (research_guide: `lexicon`).
queries.title: Queries

query.description: What the user is looking for, as they typed it.
query.title: Query

session.description: The `session` value the sign-in returned. Pass it on every call in this conversation, so the sign-in survives however this client handles connections; omit it when the user connected with Sign in (OAuth) or a key.

type.description: 'tender' or 'grant' (use 'grant' when the user asks for grant calls).
type.title: Type

name: search_opportunities
title: Search tenders and grant calls
